title: Auto-anonymising of personal data
body:
To help organisations comply with the new GDPR and their own retenntion policies, add a new option:

automatically anonymize person data after this many years X
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Anonymising should blank all the name fields and make the surname "No longer retained". The address, email and phone numbers are wiped, but the town/county and postcode fields are left intact for statistics and reporting.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
